about: Every decision and official count we hold about Madeira (generated from graph.json by incident.researcher@web-summit.dinis).

decisions.decision: Red warnings for Madeira's south coast and mountains: rain from 21:00 Tuesday to 06:00 Wednesday; wind gusts to 140 km/h from 00:00
decisions.decided_by: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
decisions.label: evidence
decisions.note: Lusa via Jornal de Negócios live 00:09 (hours); DNOTICIAS listing headline 10 Nov 07:24, "IPMA coloca costa Sul e zonas montanhosas da Madeira sob aviso vermelho". IPMA's send time not read by us (the meteorologist's CAP file covers Lisbon).

decisions.decision: Madeira schools closed on Wednesday morning, reopening from 13:00
decisions.label: evidence
decisions.note: Announced at a regional press conference by the president of the regional civil protection service (Observador 12:11:17, JSON-LD); DNOTICIAS headline 11:26 "Escolas da Madeira encerradas na manhã de quarta-feira até às 13 horas" (a search summary attributes it to the regional government). Most critical hours given as 21:00 to 06:00 (IPMA Madeira at the same conference).

decisions.decision: "Situação meteorológica adversa — Depressão Charles: medidas preventivas"; the page lists the warnings in force by area (e.g. north coast: rain 21:00 Tue to 06:00 Wed, then 06:00 to 09:00; wind 21:00 Tue to 12:00 Wed; sea 09:00 to 21:00 Wed; south coast rain 21:00 to 06:00)

decisions.note: SRPC's own page, dateCreated 2026-11-10T15:27:01Z (Madeira = UTC in November). No official count of occurrences on it; "14 occurrences in the first hour of red" is DNOTICIAS (press, 22:00).

decisions.decision: Occurrence count, Madeira: 71 since 20:00 Tuesday, as at 02:00 Wednesday (22 floodings, 13 mass movements/landslides, 7 fallen trees; Machico 20, Santa Cruz 18, Câmara de Lobos 10, Funchal 10, Ponta do Sol 4, Calheta 3, Porto Santo 1, Ribeira Brava 1, Santana 1, 3 unassigned; 193 responder deployments, 72 vehicle mobilisations)
decisions.label: evidence
decisions.note: DN Madeira (by Rúben Santos) via SAPO, published 02:10:06Z, modified 02:29:08Z: "segundo a mais recente actualização da plataforma de informação à comunicação social da Protecção Civil Regional, consultada pelas 2h00". The count is SRPC's, but read through its press-information platform, which is not public. SRPC's public site (procivmadeira.pt news list, read 03:51Z) carries no count: its latest items are the measures page (2158, 10 Nov 15:27) and Aviso 17/2026 (2157, created 6 Nov 11:31). Earlier counts in the press: 14 (DNOTICIAS 22:00), 26 to 22:30, 38, 42 (Funchal Notícias). "Fallen trees 7" per the article; the Wikipedia lead matches.
